slices.focus: Post-birthday kitchen-table talk with Erin yields weekly family night and monthly no-tools Sunday
slices.summary: After his birthday, Derek and Erin have a blunt but calm conversation in their unfinished dining room about how every free weekend gets consumed by union prep, side work, or Logan drama. They agree on two concrete boundaries: one protected family night every week and one no-tools Sunday every month. Derek realizes he had been treating free time as leftover scrap rather than a household resource, and that the half-renovated house itself was part of the stress. He commits to stock sentences for saying no and to not reading the house like a report card.
open_loops: Protecting the first no-tools Sunday when a renovation temptation arises
Developing a stock sentence for declining extra obligations
Communicating the new boundaries to Logan and managing his mother's reaction
Separating the renovation queue into manageable steps vs. overwhelming whole-house view
decisions: Derek's relationship status shifted from general marital strain around weekends to clearer boundaries with Erin around f
